title: Battle of Dungeness
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Dungeness", at revision 1382431475, opens: "The naval Battle of Dungeness took place on 30 November 1652 during the First Anglo-Dutch War near the cape of Dungeness in Kent." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1576717, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1652 first Anglo-Dutch War naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
